name: Dried squid
summary: Con Market’s outdoor counters name grilled dried squid. The 5 Jul 2023 OCOP page describes mực khô Hạng Huệ from Thanh Khê: squid dried after the jig boats come in, white on the belly, pale pink on the back, with faint dark spots.
origin: Thanh Khê’s squid-jigging boats, on the OCOP page. The grilled plate is the Con Market outdoor list.
texture: The OCOP page says that once grilled and torn, the meat is pale pink, chewy, and does not crumble.
howToEat: Grill it. The OCOP page describes the grilled meat. Con Market names grilled dried squid on the outdoor counters and does not name a stall.
The producer address on the OCOP page is 145 Kỳ Đồng, Thanh Khê Đông. That is the drying house, not a restaurant ranking.
where: Outdoor counters at Con Market, on the 19 Jun 2019 roundup and the 4 Oct 2024 market page. Hạng Huệ’s address on the 5 Jul 2023 page is 145 Kỳ Đồng, Thanh Khê Đông.
seoTitle: Dried squid — muc kho in Da Nang
seoDescription: Con Market names grilled dried squid. Hạng Huệ in Thanh Khê dries squid that grills pale pink and chewy. A stall price is Check on arrival.
